gallery.artist: Harvey Barrison from Massapequa, NY, USA
gallery.description: Museu Nacional dos Coches [National Coach Museum] is located in the Belém district. The museum was created in 1905 by Queen Amélia to house an extensive collection of carriages belonging to the Portuguese royal family and nobility. The collection gives a full picture of the development of carriages from the late 16th through the 19th centuries, with carriages made in Italy, Portugal, France, Spain, Austria and England.
